description: Two slew limiters that can be driven into cycling, each with a hold input and an end comparator, and a comparator across the two of them

params.text: Chooses what that cell's hold input does: up for Sample and Hold, where one step of slew passes on each rising edge, down for Track and Hold, where the cell freezes while the gate is high
Scales that cell's attenuverted rate input, -1 to +1, before it is added to the rate
Sets that cell's slew rate, an octave a step from about 0.03Hz to about 11600Hz

inputs.text: Forces 0V onto that cell's input while the voltage is above 1.8V, so the cell slews down towards zero
Freezes that cell: in Sample and Hold a rising edge past 1.8V lets one step of slew through, and in Track and Hold the cell is frozen for as long as the voltage stays above 1.8V
Added to that cell's rate through its attenuverter, a volt an octave
Added to that cell's rate with no attenuation, a volt an octave

outputs.text: That cell's slewed signal, following the voltage range of what is fed into it
-5V once that cell's output reaches +5V and +5V once it reaches -5V, which makes the cell cycle when it is patched back into that cell's input
5V while the left cell's output is above the right cell's, and -5V otherwise

notes: patch a cell's END output back into its own IN with the switch down, in Track and Hold, and the cell cycles: a triangle at OUT and a square at END, tuned by the RATE knob
patching a cell's OUT or END back into its own CV input bends the wave, because that is self frequency modulation; the rate needs retuning afterwards
every input in this module reads one channel, so polyphonic cables are cut down to their first channel
